rules.inheritance: A child extends parent capabilities. A protected parent cannot be weakened. Record/features are unioned and common frame sizes are intersected.
rules.security_suite: All profiles in a closure MUST resolve to the same registered suite unless an explicit experimental test composition is requested.
rules.fec_policy: A child MAY refine a parent FEC policy only through an explicit `extends` relation in registries/fec-policies.json. Unrelated policy changes fail closed.
rules.max_records: Resolved max_records is the minimum across the closure.
rules.replay_window: The leaf replay-window value is transcript-bound and local resource admission is mandatory.
rules.resources: Profile resolution never implies resource admission; every runtime performs local admission before activation/rekey.
rules.unknown_noncritical: MAY be skipped and surfaced diagnostically.
rules.generated_contract: Resolved manifests bind suite IDs/status, FEC algorithm IDs/bounds, record set and inheritance closure so different runtimes cannot silently reinterpret profile names.

overlay_constraints.rule: Padding/cover traffic remains subordinate to emergency/control reservations and negotiated congestion ceilings.
FEC/interleaving cannot increase resource allocation solely from unauthenticated feedback.
